'''Jurgen's bandits''' was a minor group of bandits active on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The bandits were led by [[Jurgen Nath]], a criminal involved in the kidnapping and murder of [[Felicia]], the daughter of [[Wernell Covington]], years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Narmle Militia]] was able to provide the last knownlocation of Nath to Wernell Covington and the latter dispatched a spacer to [[Jurgen Nath's Hideout]]. The spacer fought and eliminated several bandits during the attack. Covington's henchman eventually killed Jurgen Nath in the depths of the bunker, avenging the murder of Felicia Covington.<ref name="SWG:V" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jurgen's bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jurgen's bandits was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
